integrity: Single explicit theorem; proof includes probability positivity iff, unique source, isotropic sharp displacement threshold; Gaussian marginal does not mean Gaussian temporal process. All reproducibility files supplied directly.
scientific_limitations: Independent Poisson resets of a stable linear diffusion with strictly positive-definite driving diffusion and nondegenerate Gaussian target; exact population law, no finite-sample or finite-reset-cost claim. The inverse-source generator relation and forward OU renewal formulas are pre-existing; broader inverse-control coverage remains possible.
title: Exact Gaussian stationary-state engineering by non-Gaussian stochastic resets
